description.p: LocalPDF Studio is a free, open-source, privacy-first PDF toolkit built to work 100% offline — no document uploads, no cloud required. Whether you’re merging PDFs, splitting large files, extracting images, adding watermarks, or locking/unlocking documents, this tool gives you full control — without compromising your privacy. Stop uploading your PDF files to random websites that may use or sell your sensitive documents, install LocalPDF Studio right now.

ul.li: Add comment, hand signature, highlight, text, drawing or image (Powered by Mozilla PDF.js)
Split large PDFs into smaller parts
Delete, reorder, or crop pages with ease
Convert PDF pages to high-quality images
Lock or unlock PDFs with passwords
Edit metadata and extract images from documents
Perform OCR on image or PDF files
Redact PDF content as you wish
Works fully offline, with full support for Windows, macOS (Intel), and Linux
Built using modern, efficient technologies for speed and minimal footprint
100% Offline & Private: Your documents stay local. Nothing is uploaded.
Free & Open Source (AGPL-3.0): No cost, no lock-in.
Cross-Platform: One tool for all your devices: Windows, Linux, macOS.
Lightweight: Fast startup, modern backend, minimal system stress.
